name: input
title: Input
description: Text fields cut into the surface, with labels, hints, errors and groups.
use: A value the reader types: a name, an email, a message, a date. Put it in a field so it has a label, and in an input group when an icon, a unit or a button belongs to it.

instead.when: The value is one of a short list of plain options
The value is found by typing into a long list
It is a number the reader steps up and down often
It is a short code typed one character to a slot

platform.fallback: An input-auto textarea keeps its minimum height and the resize handle
Firefox keeps its own marks in date, time, number and search fields

classes.name: input
classes.description: A text input, a file input or a textarea, drawn as a well; it also draws the browser's date, time, number, search and color fields

classes.name: input-sm
classes.description: 32px tall; the default is 38px, a button's height

classes.name: input-lg
classes.description: 44px tall; the default is 38px, a button's height

classes.name: input-auto
classes.description: A textarea that grows with its content, from --input-rows to --input-max-rows lines, then scrolls

classes.name: input-group
classes.description: One well around a bare field and its icon, addon or button; it draws the hover, focus, invalid and disabled states of the field inside it

classes.name: input-group-sm
classes.description: A group 32px tall; the default is 38px

classes.name: input-group-lg
classes.description: A group 44px tall; the default is 38px

classes.name: input-group-wrap
classes.description: A group that collects several values as chips and grows by lines; adding and removing a value is the page's own script or a round trip to the server

classes.name: input-group-field
classes.description: The bare native field inside a group; it keeps the semantics and the caret

classes.name: input-group-addon
classes.description: Fixed text beside the value, such as a protocol, a unit or a domain

classes.name: field
classes.description: A label stacked over its control, with optional guidance below; a label element, or a div that holds a label with for

classes.name: field-hint
classes.description: Muted guidance under the control; inside a field it steps aside while the error shows

classes.name: field-error
classes.description: The danger message; it shows only while a control in the field is invalid

classes.name: fieldset
classes.description: A fieldset that groups related controls under one caption, without the browser's groove

classes.name: fieldset-legend
classes.description: The legend: the group's caption, in the voice of a field label

states.name: invalid
states.description: A danger contour that stays while focused; the field-error in the same field shows and replaces the hint

states.name: user-invalid
states.description: The same drawing from the browser's own constraints (required, type, pattern), once the reader has edited the field or tried to submit

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled ink on the value and the placeholder

states.name: read-only
states.description: The well keeps its tone under the pointer

states.name: autofilled
states.description: Filled in by the browser: the well takes a faint tint of the info color

states.name: invalid
states.description: Or :user-invalid: the group takes the danger contour

states.name: disabled
states.description: The group and everything in it take disabled ink

states.name: autofilled
states.description: The whole group takes the tint

properties.name: --input-height
properties.description: Minimum block size of an input or an input group; 2.75rem on touch screens

properties.name: --input-padding-x
properties.description: Inline padding of an input or an input group

properties.name: --input-radius
properties.description: Corner radius: 10px, with 8px for small and 12px for large

properties.name: --input-rows
properties.description: The fewest lines an input-auto textarea shows

properties.name: --input-max-rows
properties.description: The most lines an input-auto textarea grows to before it scrolls
